scope.information_unit: Causally finalized Ethereum Aave V2 and V3 Pool LiquidationCall logs: actual collateral transfer and debt repayment, not CEX liquidation prints or inferred inventory.
scope.source_gate: Keyless historical eth_getLogs access, pinned official Aave address book, canonical event ABI, block timestamps, decoding and event density. No market outcome is opened in this phase.
scope.model: Exactly one fixed HistGradientBoosting first-passage classifier and one fixed calibration rule after the source gate.
scope.decision: Exactly one cost-adjusted LONG/SHORT/FLAT rule toward two prior-only structural ETH liquidity objectives.
scope.execution: ETHUSDT USDT-linear perpetual only; one global pending/open slot; options and on-chain assets are signal-only.
scope.chronology: 2021 through 2022H1 fit, 2022H2 calibration, 2023H1 untouched confirmation, 2023H2 conditional development. Official 2024-2026 remains sealed.
non_overlap: CEX forced-liquidation burst work observes exchange liquidation messages; this claim observes immutable DeFi collateral transfer and debt repayment on Ethereum.
Inventory-map, OI, funding and taker-flow work infer vulnerable positions from exchange state; this claim uses completed protocol liquidation events only.
No cross-venue latency, mark/index premium, option, maker, stable-quote, macro or ordinary price-lead input is admitted.
scope.prohibited_tuning: No model family, feature subset, event-window, threshold, target, stop, risk or leverage grid.
